zh.summary: 一家慈善商店以5英镑的价格提供二手学校制服，帮助因生活成本压力而苦恼的家庭负担必要的返校物品。该倡议为面临新制服费用的低收入家庭提供了一个经济实惠的替代方案。

title: Trump administration to invest $3 billion in minerals projects to boost U.S. defense supply chains
summary: The Trump administration plans to invest $3 billion in minerals projects to strengthen U.S. defense capabilities and reduce dependence on Chinese supply chains. The investment aims to replenish weapons stockpiles depleted during recent conflicts while building domestic critical minerals production capacity.
content: The White House needs critical minerals to replenish weapons stockpiles depleted during the Iran conflict and reduce U.S. dependence on Chinese supply chains.

zh.title: 特朗普政府将投资30亿美元用于矿产项目以增强美国防御供应链
zh.summary: 特朗普政府计划投资30亿美元用于矿产项目，以加强美国防御能力并减少对中国供应链的依赖。该投资旨在补充在最近冲突中耗尽的武器库存，同时建立国内关键矿产生产能力。

title: Inside the startup drone maker powering Ukraine's deep-strike campaign
summary: Fire Point, a Ukrainian startup drone maker, is playing a key role in Ukraine's military operations. CEO Iryna Terekh argues that military strength is crucial to achieving favorable diplomatic negotiations.
content: Fire Point CEO Iryna Terekh says Ukraine has "learned the hard way" that military leverage is integral to to bringing diplomacy within reach.

zh.title: 深入乌克兰深度打击无人机制造商的初创公司
zh.summary: Fire Point是乌克兰一家初创无人机制造商，在乌克兰军事行动中发挥了关键作用。首席执行官伊琳娜·特列克主张，军事力量对于达成有利的外交谈判至关重要。
